content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CCI Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CCI Consultant (Chemical) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultant (Chemical) position at CCI is scheduled for 28 August 2026. Candidates should report for registration at the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Consultant (Chemical) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is Intermediate. However, significant experience is also a key requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Consultant (Chemical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Consultant (Chemical) post is 64 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Chemical) role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant (Chemical) position is negotiable, allowing for discussion based on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Consultant (Chemical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Consultant (Chemical) position at the Cement Corporation of India.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at CCI Ltd., Tandur Cement Factory, Karankote Village, Tandur Mandal, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501158.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job, offered on a Fixed Term Contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested copies of testimonials for educational qualifications, experience, date of birth, community, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any preference given for specific experience?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with experience in the Cement Industry.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should report for registration at 10:00 am on 28 August 2026.
